note: LOCAL backend policy adopted from fixed L1J normal/blessed/cursed weapon and armor enchant rules. This is not evidence of Classic probabilities, grade wire encoding or client behavior. IDs are Classic templates; grade is separate local instance input.
grade_ref: data/m1/drops.json:6; game_data.DropDef; docs/NPC_FIELD_SEMANTICS.md:49. Reuses existing npc f21.f2 grade0/1/2 correspondence. Grade is never inferred from item25/26 template alone; live instance wire delivery remains unconnected.

rules.outcome: roll=1..100, strict roll < integer threshold; source Java integer division
rules.safe: noncursed and level<safe: success. safe<0 or target bless>=128: reject without consuming. target kind and scroll eligibility must match.
rules.cursed: level>-7: -1; level<=-7: destroy. Cursed check precedes safe.
rules.blessed_delta: level<=2: +1 rolls1..32,+2 rolls33..76,+3 rolls77..100; level3..5: +2 rolls1..49,+1 rolls50..100; level>=6:+1

mapping_limits: Mapping follows work/local_original_session/game-core-prep/MAPPING_SCOPE.md section3: match Classic name token and Korean name, distinguish weapon/armor scroll use, then select the L1J variant by the separate drop grade. The shared token alone leaves three grade candidates per template.
Never use the six L1J variant IDs as Classic IDs. Classic templates25/26 and their grade0/1/2 drop combinations are supported by existing evidence. A template ID alone does not determine grade.

Base-template correspondence uses name token, name, scroll family and f5/f6 graphics: Classic25/$244/weapon corresponds to L1J scroll/dai, Classic26/$249/armor to scroll/zel. All three L1J candidates in each family share the token and graphics; their SQL bless0/1/2 selects blessed/normal/cursed. Native weight625 differs from L1J630.
Classic correspondence for IvoryTower/quest/illusion equipment requiring special scrolls is unresolved. Equipment outside this table requires explicit safe_enchant and normal_scroll_eligible=True.
GM success bypass, elemental/accessory/IvoryTower/quest/illusion scrolls are outside this LOCAL module scope.
